    AI Overview
    Purdue University's main campus is located in West Lafayette, Indiana, situated along the Wabash River. It is approximately one hour north of Indianapolis and two hours south of Chicago. The university also has a growing campus presence in Indianapolis. 
    Key Details About the Location: 
    • City: West Lafayette, which is part of the Lafayette-West Lafayette twin city area.
    • Campus Size: The main campus spans over 2,600 acres.
    • Environment: A classic, large college town setting that blends historical sites with modern campus facilities.
    • Expansion: Purdue has established a comprehensive urban campus in Indianapolis. 
    The university is a major public research institution often referred to as the Home of Purdue or Purdue University - Wikipedia.

    Description

    Purdue University is a public land-grant research university in West Lafayette, Indiana, United States, and the flagship campus of the Purdue University system, which also includes Purdue University in Indianapolis as an ongoing expansion of the West Lafayette campus. Wikipedia
    Address: 610 Purdue Mall, West Lafayette, IN 47907
    Acceptance rate: 49.9% (2024) IPEDS
    Undergraduate tuition and fees: In-state tuition 9,992 USD, Out-of-state tuition 28,794 USD (2023 – 24) IPEDS
    Campus: Small city, 2,660 acres (10.8 km2)
    Mascot: Boilermaker Special, Purdue Pete
    Students: 57,876 (fall 2025)
    President: Mung Chiang
    Nickname: Boilermakers
    Colors: Old gold and black;
    Early action decision date: Jan. 15 purdue.edu
    Established: May 6, 1869; 156 years ago
    Accreditation: HLC
    Endowment: $4.44 billion (2024)
    Phone: (765) 494-4600
